text.content:
One who embodies the half-seen terrors of the dark, feeding on mistrust, uncertainty, and the fear of the unknown.

SKILLS

FALSE FACE · SL max 3

As a free action, you may spend up to (SL × 10) Mind Points to randomly convert yourself into a visual duplicate of any creature for rounds equal to (1 + (1 per 10 MP spent)). Any creature that attempts to attack a creature identical to you, including creatures who are allies to the duplicated appearance, must randomly choose between all creatures that are identical to the one you copied, aside from itself. You may reveal yourself at any time as a free action, ending the effect.

FEAR ITSELF

When you cast an Offensive Spell targeting only one creature, you may increase the Spell's total Mind Point Cost by 5 to calculate the target's base Magic Defense from their Willpower instead of their Insight.

RITUAL MESMERISM

You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the Mesmerism discipline. Mesmerism rituals use (WLP + WLP) for the Magic Check.

MESMERIST MAGIC · SL max 10

Each time you acquire this skill, learn one Mesmerist Spell. Offensive [Z] Mesmerist Spells use (WLP + WLP) for the Magic Check.

HALL OF MIRRORS · SL max 2

When you use False Face targeting any non-ally creature, you may raise the total Mind Point cost by up to (SL × 10) to spawn 1 additional illusion for every 10 Mind Points spent this way. An enemy may attempt a (WLP + INS) Opposed Check against you when attacking it. If they succeed, they may choose one identical target at random, otherwise they attack one illusion and destroy it, dealing no damage.

SPELLS

Mesmerism is the discipline of illusions, madness, uncertainty, eldritch horror, and fear. It is a discipline born by harnessing the darkest this world has to offer then turning that darkness into a blade to cut down more darkness. Sometimes light just isn't enough. The same persistent spell cannot apply twice to the same target.

ANXIETY · 10 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You heighten the latent unease in a creature's body. The target gains the shaken or dazed status effect, ignoring Immunity.

PETRIFY · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

The target's body morphs into the shape of an inanimate object of your choice, up to the size of itself, and down to a mug in size. While in this state, they cannot act but also cannot be targeted by creatures with Attacks or Spells. Any creature affected this way returns to normal at the end of the scene, or after taking any damage, or by taking a free action to exit the form at the start of their next turn. If the target is not a willing creature, this Spell becomes an Offensive Spell, and the target only remains in this form for 1 turn before returning to normal at the end of its next turn. After any creature exits this form, this Spell ends. Each creature can only be affected by this Spell once per scene.

DARK PRESENCE · 15 MP · Special · Scene

You inflict the shaken status effect on every creature in Crisis present in the scene.

GRIM VISIONS · 10 MP · Self · Scene

You plague the minds of your victims with horrible visions. As a reaction during the duration of this spell, when a shaken or dazed creature casts a Spell you may interrupt with an Opposed (WLP + WLP) Check. On a success, the counteracted Spell never happens, the enemy does not spend Mind Points, and the victim loses the shaken or dazed status, immediately ending this spell.

SUFFERING [Z] · 25 MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

For every shaken creature targeted by this spell, reduce the total Mind Point cost by 5. Each target recovers from the shaken condition and takes (HR + 10) dark damage. Then, one creature of your choice recovers Mind Points equal to half the damage dealt this way.

PREDATION · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

Choose one of the following status effects: dazed, shaken. The target of this Spell becomes immune to that status effect for the scene, and deals +2 bonus damage against those afflicted by the chosen status effect (this becomes +4 at level 20, and +6 at level 40).

NIGHTMARE [Z] · 30 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You jettison your victims' minds into the realm of nightmares, forcing them to lash out. You may only target weak and poisoned creatures, shaken and poisoned creatures, or creatures whose hit points are equal to or less than their Crisis score, with this Spell. You deal (HR + your level) ice damage to the target. If this Spell reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, they do not die and instead regain Hit Points equal to (HR), cannot regain Hit Points, and join your side in a sleepwalk. If reduced to 0 Hit Points again, or at the end of the scene, they collapse as normal. Damage dealt by this Spell ignores Resistances.

OBELISK [Z] · 30 MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

Weave a towering column of sickening fear from the souls of your victims. All targeted creatures become shaken. If they are already shaken, they lose shaken and become poisoned. If they are already poisoned, they take (HR + 10) ice damage. Damage dealt by this Spell ignores Resistances.

PANIC [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

You send a spiral of pure adrenaline into the veins of a foe, causing their limbs and mind to seize and shake. Until this spell ends, the target ignores any bonus to their Magic Defense from items, equipment, and special rules; they may only use their base Insight die size.

SHIVERS · 5 MP per target · Up to three creatures · Scene

You send a sharp chill down the nerves of your victims. Choose one damage type: poison, dark, earth, ice. Whenever a target of this Spell would suffer that damage type, its Affinity to that damage type is reduced by one step (Absorb becomes Immune, Immune becomes Resistant, Resistant becomes None, None becomes Vulnerable).

SKINSUIT · 20 MP · One creature · Unique

You weave a potent illusion over a creature, granting them the effect of False Face targeting a creature of your choice until the end of the next round. You may choose to spend up to (SL in False Face × 5) additional Mind Points to extend the duration by another round per 5 additional Mind Points spent, and may use the Hall of Mirrors skill by paying its appropriate Mind Point cost as well. The target gains the ability to be targeted by its allies.

CHOKE [Z] · 15 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You pulse a wave of black blood into the hearts of your victim. The target suffers (HR + 10) poison damage, and suffers the poisoned status effect. If the target was already poisoned, this damage increases by 10.

WYRD · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

You warp the image of yourself or an ally into an abomination from your foes' worst nightmares, catching them off guard. As part of an attack, the target of this Spell may declare to consume this Spell. If they do so, they receive an Opportunity on a success, regardless of whether it is a critical success or not. Then, this spell ends.

ZERO: BODY · 30 MP · Special · Scene

You may only target slow or weak creatures with this Spell, to a maximum of one creature. You drain the last of a creature's bodily strength, making them fumble the next action they take if it uses the afflicted attribute(s). If the target is both slow and weak, this Spell costs 5 additional Mind Points and lasts for 2 checks instead of one; one check per afflicted attribute.

ZERO: LIFE [Z] · 30 MP · Special · Scene

You may only target creatures who are poisoned or enraged. You flare up the maladies writhing in their bodies, weakening their immune system and spreading their suffering like a pathogen. You deal (HR + 25) ice damage to the target. Any target hit by this Spell cannot remove your choice of poisoned or enraged by any means until this spell ends, and loses any immunity to or special bonuses it gets from the chosen status effect. A creature can only be affected by this Spell once at any time.

ZERO: SOUL · 30 MP · Special · Scene

You may only target dazed or shaken creatures with this Spell, to a maximum of one creature. You drain the last of a creature's sense of self, making them fumble the next action they take if it uses the afflicted attribute(s). If the target is both dazed and shaken, this Spell costs 5 additional Mind Points and lasts for 2 actions instead of one; one action negated per afflicted attribute.
